155 . Many trinomials of the form $x^{2} + b x + c$ factor into the product of two binomials $(x + m) (x + n) .$ Explain how you find the values of m and n .
156 . Tommy factored $x^{2} - x - 20$ as $(x + 5) (x - 4) .$ Sara factored it as $(x + 4) (x - 5) .$ Ernesto factored it as $(x - 5) (x - 4) .$ Who is correct? Explain why the other two are wrong.
